materials.name: WoodWalnut
materials.description: European walnut furniture hardwood, oiled/waxed finish. Warm dark chocolate-brown heartwood, deliberately distinct from the light oak floor (Wood) so furniture reads clearly indoors. Period-valid for continental-medieval / fantasy settings (walnut was a prized furniture wood in medieval France & Italy; strictly English-medieval common furniture would use oak/elm). Source: ambientCG Wood051 (CC0).
